criterion: AC7 (PRD section 18, verbatim): 500 streams survive a rolling deploy
methodology: In-cluster pod (curlimages/curl) opens 500 concurrent SSE streams against http://gateway:8080 (the real Service, not kubectl port-forward - see docs/design/kubernetes-deployment.md for why port-forward gives a false failure here). mock-primary configured with stream_delay_ms=15000 so each stream runs ~105s. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway` triggered ~2s after all 500 streams confirmed launched. Each stream checked for a data:[DONE] terminator vs. a broken connection.
result: AC7 met: 0/500 broken streams across both runs, each run confirmed to genuinely overlap the rollout via ReplicaSet hash change and fresh pod ages.
